notes: The full unit suite was followed by focused tests for the final debounce, cancelled-job replacement and textless-PDF changes; CI repeats the full suite before publication.
Real-library native acceptance uses one representative fixture per format to limit local downloads. The prior larger content sweep timed out in WebView2 and is not claimed as passed.
The PDF fixtures are image-based: native acceptance verifies the no-searchable-text outcome. EPUB acceptance verifies whole-book matches and CFI resolution without a local original.
No physical Android or iOS device acceptance was performed. Phone layouts were exercised on Windows browser engines.
Background synchronization continues only while the application is running. Tasks are not resumed after exit.
